objective: Define how the reviewed native-parser adapter payload may reach the existing sidecar stage-plan surface, without moving target selection, source closure, coverage-output target selection, host-probe metadata, state/report paths, compare labels, execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, or automatic allocation into the parser layer.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted adapter payload still has no target, mode, template identity, source gate, coverage manifest, or host-probe metadata. Resolving a sidecar plan from only parser-preserved Verilator inputs would silently infer repo-specific semantics from parser evidence and violate the prior handoff boundary.
definition_decision.operator_goal: A future native Verilator parser path should first produce the reviewed adapter payload. A separate sidecar plan-resolution layer may then combine that payload with explicit sidecar context to call or mirror the existing sidecar stage-plan helpers.

required_before_plan_resolution: source gate or manifest reference when coverage-output target selection needs one
conditional_inputs: template metadata for generated host-probe and state/report path rules
required_explicit_sidecar_context.filelist_rule: filelists from parser payload remain preserved input paths until an explicit sidecar policy or reviewed template source-closure gate authorizes expansion.

correctness_policy_ref_mapping.meaning: reference-only requirement for the later sidecar compare stage

forbidden_boundary_crossings: target registry lookup from parser-owned fields alone
source closure inference in the parser or adapter payload
filelist dependency inference before a reviewed sidecar policy
coverage manifest selection by the parser
host-probe metadata selection by the parser
state or report path materialization by the parser
compare label generation by the parser
calling sidecar_handoff_contract from the parser adapter
calling synthesized_verilator_command_argv from the parser adapter
calling sidecar_operator_plan from the parser adapter
calling shim_report or CLI main paths from the parser adapter
calling efficiency_estimate from the parser adapter
treating correctness_policy_ref as CPU-vs-hybrid compare evidence
automatic GPU allocation or optimal block-size selection

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the adapter payload is correctly limited to parser-owned inputs plus guard metadata
whether explicit target/mode/template or registry context is required before sidecar plan resolution
whether sidecar-owned source closure, coverage-output target selection, host-probe metadata, state/report paths, compare labels, and final compare policy remain outside the parser layer
whether correctness_policy_ref is only a reference to a later sidecar compare policy and not compare evidence
whether the definition avoids runtime, execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression, and upstream landing claims
must_not_claim: native Verilator parser support beyond the scoped parser smoke
coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a new public CLI or workflow
not parser inference of coverage manifests, host-probe metadata, source closure, state paths, or report paths
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
